profile and hotkey report
- approximated profile "Recording quality": OBS's "Small" recording quality became constant quality 23.
- approximated profile "Recording format": RBS does not record flv files, so the recording uses MKV. MKV keeps the recording when the computer stops suddenly.
- skipped profile "Stream server": OBS picked the server automatically, which RBS does not do yet. Enter the server address in Settings › Stream.
